g.text: From a user script to a solved S-parameter / far-field result: public API, structure builders, the SimTools orchestration hub, and the two backend engines it dispatches to.
Every structure class (patch antenna, microstrip line, quarter-wave filter) walks the same layers; standalone_model.py enters lower down, skipping the builder step.
alt entry — skips builder, no CSX needed
patch dims · Hammerstad-Jensen Z0 · inset depth
Mesh — FDTD grid from CSX primitives (thirds rule)
7 fem_* modules, lazily imported — see fem_architecture.svg
shared Rich console/theme — imported by 8+ modules
CadQuery STEP export — also reused by fem_backend
cli.py is a standalone Typer CLI ('simpleems checkhealth') — own Console instance, no relative imports into the package above.
Solid grey = import. Dashed purple = external tool. Structure-class boxes are grouped; the FEM subsystem is collapsed (see fem_architecture.svg for its internals).
SimParams and SimTools are the two base classes every structure inherits from. SimSetup/SimData (NamedTuple) and DumpType (Enum) are the shared data contracts, defined in sim_tools.py.
freqs, s11, s21, z11, vswr, input_power, …
All defined once in sim_tools.py and shared
by both the FDTD and FEM backends unchanged.
